tools.name: analyze_design
tools.description: Profile a proposed feature, system or AI-agent workflow and return documented incidents from systems that behaved similarly, their failure patterns, and the safeguards to build in. Use before writing code for anything that moves money, deletes data, changes permissions, runs code, or acts on externa

tools.name: analyze_existing_app
tools.description: Analyze an existing app using observed behavior, README, architecture notes, configuration or source snippets. Provide a public GitHub repository_url to import selected context, or inspect a private repository locally and submit relevant text. Code is never executed and the running app is not scanne

tools.name: search_incidents
tools.description: Keyword search over documented incidents and security advisories (company, technology, CVE, failure mode). Returns titles, summaries, evidence labels and URLs.

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: Full record for one incident by ID (e.g. SEA-POST-005): what happened, source, failure pattern, safeguards and review status.

tools.name: list_failure_patterns
tools.description: The 14 recurring failure patterns with triggers, warning signs and engineering principles.

tools.name: get_safeguards
tools.description: Return ready-to-save rules (AGENTS.md by default; also CLAUDE.md, Cursor rule or Copilot instructions) for a proposed design, each rule citing the incidents behind it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_incidents, get_incident · Private data: analyze_existing_app, get_incident · Public sink: analyze_existing_app, get_incident.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_incidents, get_incident · Private data: analyze_existing_app, get_incident · Public sink: analyze_existing_app, get_incident

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
